findings.message: Track 1 states an output sampling frequency of NaN Hz, which RFC 9559 forbids (section 5.1.4.1.29.2); it is not used, so no AudioSpecificConfig is worked out from the legacy SBR codec ID and the AAC parser gets no configuration.
The container hands over AAC without an AudioSpecificConfig, so the object type, sample rate and channels are unknown.
